fusions.name: Snapped Staghorn
fusions.desc: Breaks a branch of reef off your own back and hurls it at a target up to 5 tiles away for 8 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Breaker on the Reef
fusions.desc: Breaks a wave over the reef on your back, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. It always strikes critically and leaves them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Sheltering Shoal
fusions.desc: Grows a reef where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 4 tiles. The effect grows 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Polyp by Polyp
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, you gain a shield worth 6% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
